newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices undermined by NYMEX selloff.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices undermined by NYMEX selloff.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell about 1.5 cents a gallon on Friday, matching their Thursday losses in another NYMEX heating oil selloff, players said.
Differentials were little changed, however, in lackluster trade ahead of the weekend, traders said.
New York Harbor 54-grade aviation-quality material was offered at 2.00 cents above the February print, while Gulf Coast back-second-cycle material held steady at about 2.75 cents under.
Gulf low sulfur 55-grade was offered at about a 0.85 cent premium to 54-grade, traders said.
